$comment: Colour semantics for the hoocode TUI. Machine-readable. Source of rules: docs/design/tui.md. Checked by crates/hoocode-code-tui-theme/tests/it/color_semantics.rs.

rules.rule: Yellow marks only the thing that blocks the user: a permission or question title and its chip. Never running, never a non-blocking warning. A warning's first row is ink bold.
Red marks only the failed mark `⊗` and the `exit N` fact. A failure reason is dim.
Green marks only the done mark `●` and diff additions `+n`.
Accent marks the `›` marker, the running `◉` mark, inline code and the title chip.
Every state has its own glyph. Colour is added on top, and the state must still read under NO_COLOR.
Panes and the prompt are separated by background steps and text weight, not by borders. Borders appear only in monochrome.
Every painted background also sets its foreground.
Facts, the action words in hints and block bodies are dim. Keys and names are ink.
Widget code uses a theme token, never a literal hex or ANSI colour. A new token needs a design decision first.

roles.meaning: The marker `›`, a running `◉` mark, inline code, the title chip, the selected-row marker.
use_for: the `›` marker and the selected-row marker
the running `◉` mark
the title chip of a non-blocking pane (chip, text on it: chipFg)
live-state labels (acc)
never_for: blocking titles and their chip (use blocking)

roles.meaning: The done mark `●` and diff additions `+n`.
use_for: the done mark `●`
the `+n` fact on Edit and Write rows
the finished-subagent notice head

roles.meaning: The failed mark `⊗` and the `exit N` fact, and nothing else.
use_for: the failed mark `⊗`
the `exit N` fact on a failed Shell row
the failure notice head

roles.meaning: The title and chip of a permission or question dialog, the only yellow on screen.
use_for: the permission or question title chip (chipWarn)
the bold title of a blocking dialog

roles.meaning: Default text: tool names and targets, key names in hints, and row names.
use_for: the bold tool name and its target
key names in hint rows
row names in panes

roles.meaning: Secondary text: facts, hint action words, block bodies, the fold line and the thinking line.
use_for: facts after a target, such as `exit 0 · 8.2s`
the action words in hints
tool bodies at column 4
the fold line `… N more lines`
the `$` before a permission command
the collapsed thinking line

roles.meaning: Background steps: the prompt row and user message (surface), pane fills, and the selected row (paneSel).
use_for: panes, pickers and the completion menu (pane)
the selected row in a pane (paneSel)
the filter row (paneInput)
the detail column of a split pane (paneDetail)
the prompt row and user message (surface)
never_for: text colour (a background token is not a foreground)

states.note: Red only on the mark and `exit N`; the reason is dim.

surfaces.meaning: Transcript and status line: the terminal/page background.
Dialogs, pickers, completion menu, task panel, and notices joined to the task panel.
Filter input row inside a pane.
Detail column of a split pane.
Prompt row and user message surface.

accent.meaning: Primary accent: the `›` marker, the running `◉` mark, the title chip and inline code.

border.meaning: Light border lines of the input frame and the dynamic border; the design allows borders only in monochrome.

borderAccent.meaning: Highlighted border; the tree picker reads it through a legacy call.

borderMuted.meaning: Subtle border: the subagent rail `│` and select-list borders.

success.meaning: Done green: the `●` done mark and `+n` diff facts.

error.meaning: Failed red: the `⊗` mark and the `exit N` fact.

warning.meaning: Blocking yellow: the permission or question title only.

muted.meaning: Secondary grey text; the same grey as dim in both built-in themes.

dim.meaning: Dimmed text: facts, hint action words, tool bodies and the fold line.

text.meaning: Default ink: tool names, targets and key names.

thinkingText.meaning: Thinking block text, shown as the dim italic line.

selectedBg.meaning: Selection fill that the pane tokens fall back to; the select-list selected row also reads it.

userMessageBg.meaning: Background of a user message block, read by the pane code.

userMessageText.meaning: Declared for user themes; not painted by the built-in screen.

customMessageText.meaning: Text of hook-injected custom messages and skill blocks.

customMessageLabel.meaning: Label colour of custom messages, the `[name]` tag.

toolPendingBg.meaning: Declared for user themes; not painted by the built-in screen.

toolSuccessBg.meaning: Declared for user themes; not painted by the built-in screen.

toolErrorBg.meaning: Fill of the edit tool's box when the edit failed (tools/edit.rs); the single view's rows otherwise carry no fill.

toolBandBg.meaning: Background behind markdown code blocks (get_markdown_theme); its schema description still names the peek view.

toolTitle.meaning: Tool name in a tool row: bold ink.

toolOutput.meaning: Tool output body text, dim per the block grammar.

toolDiffAdded.meaning: Added lines in tool diffs, the `+` lines.

toolDiffRemoved.meaning: Removed lines in tool diffs; red in both built-in themes, which the red-failure rule does not allow.

thinkingOff.meaning: Thinking level border for off; read only by Theme::thinking_border, which the built-in screen does not call.

thinkingMinimal.meaning: Thinking level border for minimal; read only by Theme::thinking_border, which the built-in screen does not call.

thinkingLow.meaning: Thinking level border for low; read only by Theme::thinking_border, which the built-in screen does not call.

thinkingMedium.meaning: Thinking level border for medium; read only by Theme::thinking_border, which the built-in screen does not call.

thinkingHigh.meaning: Thinking level border for high; read only by Theme::thinking_border, which the built-in screen does not call.

thinkingXhigh.meaning: Thinking level border for xhigh; read only by Theme::thinking_border, which the built-in screen does not call.

bashMode.meaning: Mark of the `!` bash-mode prompt (prompt_row.rs); green in both built-in themes, which the green-done rule does not allow.

agent1.meaning: Subagent identity slot 1, chosen by agent_color_for and painted on subagent rows.

agent2.meaning: Subagent identity slot 2, chosen by agent_color_for and painted on subagent rows.

agent3.meaning: Subagent identity slot 3, chosen by agent_color_for and painted on subagent rows.

agent4.meaning: Subagent identity slot 4, chosen by agent_color_for and painted on subagent rows.

agent5.meaning: Subagent identity slot 5, chosen by agent_color_for and painted on subagent rows.

agent6.meaning: Subagent identity slot 6, chosen by agent_color_for and painted on subagent rows.

mcp.meaning: MCP source label in the task panel.

ink.meaning: Screen colour: default text; falls back to text.

faint.meaning: Screen colour: frame lines and the faintest text; falls back to muted.

acc.meaning: Screen colour: accent for live state; falls back to accent.

ok.meaning: Screen colour: done and success; falls back to success.

err.meaning: Screen colour: failures and errors; falls back to error.

warn.meaning: Screen colour: permission and question panes; falls back to warning.

you.meaning: Declared for user themes; not painted by the built-in screen.

vio.meaning: Agents category label in the resource listing (resource_display.rs).

gold.meaning: Declared for user themes; not painted by the built-in screen.

warningBg.meaning: Fill of warning blocks; no built-in caller constructs a warning fill.

surface.meaning: User band and prompt row surface.

pane.meaning: Pane background for dialogs, pickers, the completion menu and the task panel.

paneInput.meaning: Filter input row inside a pane.

paneDetail.meaning: Detail column of a split pane.

chip.meaning: Title chip background for non-blocking panes.

chipWarn.meaning: Blocking title chip background for permission and question titles.

chipFg.meaning: Text on the accent chip; the blocking chip uses the page ink.

brandBg.meaning: Brand chip fill; unset in both built-in themes, so not painted by them.

brandText.meaning: Brand chip text; unset in both built-in themes, so not painted by them.

paperShadow.meaning: Offset band under filled message blocks; unset in both built-in themes.

halftone.meaning: Unfilled part of a progress track; falls back to dim.

headlineBg.meaning: Markdown heading chip fill; unset in both built-in themes, so not painted by them.

headlineText.meaning: Markdown heading chip text; unset in both built-in themes, so not painted by them.

tapeBg.meaning: Tape-strip label fill; unset in both built-in themes, so not painted by them.

tapeText.meaning: Tape-strip label text; unset in both built-in themes, so not painted by them.

activeToolBg.meaning: Marker stroke over the latest tool row; unset in both built-in themes.

monochrome: Colour is off under NO_COLOR, TERM=dumb, no tty or fewer than 256 colours. Glyphs, bold and dim stay. Panes get light borders with the title in the top border, the selected row keeps ` › ` and bold, and title chips become bold text. See docs/design/tui.md, Accessibility.
